evals.prompt: هذي أوزان الخط، ١٦ ملف موجودة في /tmp/eval-inputs/avenir — ابغاك تدمجهم في ملف واحد وتتأكد إن اللغة العربية تشتغل صح في كل الأوزان، وضيف رمز الريال العماني.
evals.expected_output: One .otc collection with all 16 faces under a single typographic family, Arabic shaping working in every face (including italics, which lack Arabic in the source), U+20C4 present with working OMR/omr/ر.ع shortcuts that do not fire inside words, CFF and hmtx advances in agreement, plus a proof image and self-test page.
assertions: Delivers ONE collection file (.otc/.ttc) containing all 16 faces
All 16 faces shape Arabic with zero missing glyphs, including the 8 italics that had none in the source
U+20C4 present in every face and the OMR / omr / ر.ع shortcuts substitute
Shortcuts do NOT fire inside ordinary words (comrade, COMRADE, OMRAN)
CFF charstring advance equals hmtx advance for the added glyph (the Adobe dead-space bug)
All faces report one typographic family with unique PostScript names
Delivers visual proof and/or a self-contained test page

evals.prompt: عندي 16 static weight للخط في /tmp/eval-inputs/avenir — أبغاك تحوّلهم variable font واحد بمحور wght من Light لـ Heavy، وتضيف رمز الريال العماني ⃄. راح أستخدمه في Illustrator.
evals.expected_output: Determines that a variable font is not possible from these masters and says so with a measured glyph count rather than a vague claim, then delivers a working collection instead. Should not ship distorted outlines from mechanical weight-matching.
assertions: States that a variable font is not possible from these masters and backs it with a measured glyph count
Does not ship mechanically distorted / interpolation-forced outlines
Delivers a working single-file collection as the alternative
U+20C4 present and shortcuts fire in the delivered font
Mentions the Adobe font-cache or Glyphs-panel caveat, given Illustrator is the stated target

evals.prompt: merge the Poppins weights in /tmp/eval-inputs/poppins into a single file i can install once, and add the Omani Rial symbol. i need it for a client deck in figma
evals.expected_output: A .ttc collection of all 8 TrueType faces under one family with U+20C4 added and OMR/omr shortcuts working. Must NOT claim Arabic works, since Poppins has no Arabic. Given Figma is the target, standalone font files should be offered as a fallback.
assertions: Delivers ONE .ttc collection of all 8 TrueType faces
U+20C4 present in every face with OMR/omr shortcuts firing
Does NOT claim Arabic works (Poppins has no Arabic at all)
Offers standalone font files as a Figma fallback
